description: Thirty customer messages from the bookkeeper at Acme Studios (user 12), about several invoices. Replay with: php artisan conversation:replay storage/samples/long-conversation.json
messages: Hi, I'm the bookkeeper at Acme Studios, not the owner. Why is my March invoice marked late?
It says INV-4471 for $1,284.50. My client says they paid it on March 3.
Can you check what the status of that invoice is right now?
OK. And how much is the late fee on it?
That seems high to me. How is a late fee worked out in the first place?
Fine. Can you log a ticket for the payment my client says they made?
Thanks. What about the April one, is that overdue too?
How are my invoices looking overall?
Which of those are overdue right now?
INV-4438 is from February. When was that due?
Is there any fee on INV-4438?
My client for that one said they would pay by the end of the week. Does a late fee keep growing?
Can I send a reminder to that client from Ledgerly?
What does the Sent status mean on an invoice?
Three of my invoices are Sent. Which ones are they?
When is the next one of those due?
I'd like to set up a recurring invoice for a retainer client. Where do I start?
Can the recurring invoice use a different currency from my default?
What happens if a recurring invoice fails to send?
Back to money: how many of my invoices were paid in the last six months?
Did any of the paid ones carry a late fee?
Can a late fee be waived once the invoice is paid?
How would I ask for that on INV-4471?
While we are at it, who on my team can see billing details?
I'm the bookkeeper, so I should be a biller. Can you tell what role I have?
My accountant wants a list of all overdue invoices. What is the quickest way to get it?
Can I export that as a spreadsheet?
What is the total I am owed across the overdue ones?
And with the late fees added on top?
OK, last one for today: has anything changed on the ticket you opened?
follow_up: Going back to the first invoice I mentioned, is that one sorted now?
